comment: tough grader and unlikable, and yells at his students occasionally

Please stay away at all cost. Teaches the class like its the last physics class you will take as a physics major. Class averages are very low. Teaches like there is no other class you are taking, as if this is the only class you are taking. Stay away.

Terribly boring professor and not perfect at explaining concepts but it's clear he tries and wants you to do well. The hw is tedious and the quizzes are easy. You'll have to put in the effort for the tests and he'll curve if necessary. You'll be terribly bored having him but you won't be lost in class.

I hated physics with a burning passion when I started the class, but came out actually enjoying it. Awesome demonstrations, somewhat dry lectures but straightforward. Reasonable tests plus curved at end. You will have to work for it, but you'll understand physics really well when you get out.

Great professor. He is a semi-easy grader on tests, which is great. As long as you understand the concepts you'll do fine, even if you make major mathematical mistakes. Homework took some time but that's expected. If you complete all of the homework and understand it, you'll do perfectly fine in the class. He is also very helpful outside of class

Serej is a boss!! He gives 10 minute breaks in his lecture/lab classes, homeworks are a breeze and graded  without much attention. His lectures can be dry but they are 100% clear and easy to follow, always in his office ready to answer questions etc. Labs were boring but he has some really cool demos he shows sometimes. Also he ran track in college

not the class to take if you want that easy A. You do have to study and the labs take ages. Some might find him boring, but he's willing to help till you actually get the concept in full. Good prof overall. Extremely chilled

I am typing this rating in class right now, if that gives you an idea. He is a boring teacher, but the class is easy and you can sleep of mess around during class (or not go at all). He grades pretty easily, and if you work moderately hard you will get an A.
